title: SNL Features GTA6 and Zelda in Weekend Update Skit
description: Saturday Night Live recently featured a Weekend Update skit starring GTA 6 protagonist Jason Duval and Link from The Legend of Zelda.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Saturday Night Live Takes on Gaming Giants

Popular late-night comedy television show Saturday Night Live (SNL) has once again turned its attention to the video game industry. During a recent episode, the show's signature Weekend Update segment featured a brand-new comedy skit that humorously weighed in on the cultural phenomenon surrounding major gaming titles, specifically highlighting Grand Theft Auto VI and a rumored or hypothetical remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time.

According to reports from media outlets like IGN Games, the skit featured an entertaining crossover setup starring GTA 6 protagonist Jason Duval alongside Link from The Legend of Zelda franchise. Pitting a modern, gritty open-world criminal protagonist against a classic, high-fantasy hero generated immediate comedic contrast, capturing the attention of both casual viewers and dedicated gamers alike.

## A Testament to Gaming's Cultural Impact

As video games continue to dominate modern entertainment, top-tier franchises frequently find themselves referenced or parodied in mainstream media. GTA 6 has remained a focal point of public attention since its initial announcements by Rockstar Games, while Nintendo's Zelda series holds legendary status. By bringing Jason and Link together, SNL highlighted how deeply ingrained these digital characters have become in contemporary pop culture.

While the skit was purely for comedic entertainment and did not reveal any official updates, gameplay footage, or confirmed release details for GTA 6 or the mentioned Zelda project, it successfully ignited conversations across online gaming communities. Fans took to social media platforms to discuss the unexpected pairing, proving once again that the anticipation surrounding these franchises is at an all-time high.

## Editor's Take

SNL's decision to feature Jason Duval and Link in the same skit underscores the massive cultural footprint of modern video games. Seeing gritty realism clash with classic fantasy in a comedy format is a fun reminder of how far gaming has come in the mainstream media landscape.
